_comment: Whether an HSN/SAC code names a supply of SERVICES. Read by BOTH suites:
A Service Accounting Code is Chapter 99 of the tariff; the HSN of goods runs
Chapters 1 to 98 and never begins 99. `null` is the third answer and means
the code cannot say — absent, or not a number — which is a different thing
the third state into false, which is right for its own caller (the e-way
goods/service split counts unclassified lines separately, on the code being
absent rather than on this function). So the browser column below is what
that function returns and the python column is the tri-state; where they
differ the fixture says so, rather than either side being changed to match.

cases.why: SAC — professional and technical, four digits
HSN chapter 98, project imports — NOT chapter 99
absent: python says nobody can tell, the browser's caller asks elsewhere
one digit cannot name a chapter
